name: audit-fixture-react-ssr
_comment: Hoisted compatibility audit. Peer-heavy fixture: ReactDOM declares React as a peer dep. Risk: hoisted layout could give ReactDOM a different React module instance than the user's `require('react')`, violating React's 'single instance' invariant at runtime. Smoke test renders a component to string — fails loudly if instances diverge (React's hooks dispatcher is module-scoped).
